title: Hitchhiker effect at Thomas Winterton's home

tellings.quote: Thomas has had things happen in his home upon returning from Skinwalker Ranch.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property known for reports of strange events, says that a man named Thomas Winterton has had strange things happen in his own home after coming back from the ranch. This is what people call the hitchhiker effect: the idea that whatever is at the ranch can follow visitors home. If true, it would mean the strange activity is not tied to one place.
